preconditions.description: The number of elements in the sequence b is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i < 2**60 for b_i in b)
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence b is between 1 and 2^60 - 1.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'No' or 'Yes' followed by n integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout.split()[0] == 'No' or all(b_i in b for b_i in map(int, stdout.split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', the following n integers are a permutation of the input sequence b.

postconditions.expression: stdout.split()[0] == 'No' or all(a_i < a_{i+1} for i, a_i in enumerate(a) if i < len(a) - 1)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', the sequence a_i = b'_1 ⊕ … ⊕ b'_i is strictly increasing.
